note: THE VIP EXTRA's one copy (the creator, 2026-11-10; docs/vip.md): what a VIP gets on top of every reward, read by the win checker (functions/checker/build.rs into pay.rs, which pays it) and by src/net/vip.ts (the previews UI shows before a reward is won). `coins`: the extra on each Coin payout, ceil(base * num / den), so 25 pays +13, 50 +25, 100 +50, paid as its own grant INSIDE the reward's own order (the platform pays one order a call), on the progression `progression` (on_add, 1 Coin a unit, written only by the checker; declared by tools/server/make-config.mts). `helpers`: each helper reward is multiplied by this (2: double), the extra being (helpers - 1) times the reward. `gamePays`: the game pays the Coins extra itself: FALSE since 2026-11-11, when the Arcade began paying VIP's +50% Coins on every Coins grant (the creator: "the gem arcade updated yesterday and it now pays the 50% extra for VIPs"), so the checker adds no Coins extra; the helpers stay doubled by the checker (`helpers`) until the config carries them as recipe bonuses. A coming SDK may have the Arcade tell the game the exact VIP extra (the creator): then the Arcade's figure replaces this rule at its one seam on each side (pay.rs vip_extra_coins, vip.ts vipExtraCoins) and `gamePays` goes false, so a VIP is never paid twice. `maxGrant`: the platform's most Coins in one grant (max_per_event, `gemctl platform config`): an extra past it is split. `heldMark`: the progression whose value is the highest held extra paid (an extra held while VIP could not be read, paid inside a later claim's order with this mark raised in it).
